Dear Parents,

Gentle Reminder!
As you are aware Mid-Term Assessments will commence from 1 October 2026. Kindly check the respective Class Teachers’ Teams for the assessment timetable and syllabus.
Assessment Timings (1 October to 9 October 2026):


* Arrival Time: 8:00 a.m.
* School Transport Dispersal Time: 1:30 p.m.
* Own Transport Dispersal Time : 1:15 p.m

Please note that breakfast and lunch will be at the usual timings.


To ensure that the upcoming MID TERM Examinations are conducted smoothly and without any inconvenience, we request all learners to carefully adhere to the following examination guidelines:

Learners must report to school no later than 8:10 a.m. on all examination days.
A valid School ID card must be carried at all times. Learners without an ID card will not be permitted to appear for the examination.
Learners should bring all required stationery, including blue/black pens (only for grade 5), pencils, a sharpener, a ruler, geometrical instruments, an eraser.
Only transparent pencil pouches are allowed inside the examination room.
Sharing of stationery is strictly prohibited.
Watches of any kind are not permitted in the examination hall.
The use of markers, highlighters, correction pens, staplers, or whiteners is not allowed.
Learners must strictly follow all instructions given by the exam invigilators.
Question papers should not be opened until the invigilator gives permission. Learners are advised to read all instructions carefully before attempting each section.
Learners must clearly write the candidate name, candidate number, and centre number on the answer scripts.
All questions must be attempted; no question should be left unanswered.
Any form of talking or communication with other candidates during the examination is strictly prohibited. Learners may raise their hand to seek assistance from the invigilator if required.
Learners may leave the examination room only after the exam has concluded and with the permission of the invigilator. The answer script must be submitted before leaving.

We seek the cooperation of parents in ensuring that learners are well prepared and fully compliant with these guidelines. Adhering to these instructions will help create a disciplined and stress-free examination environment for all.

We wish all our learners the very best for their examinations.

Warm regards,

Sancta Maria International School

Dear Parent,

 

We are pleased to inform you that we have initiated the registration process for the Cambridge Primary Checkpoint March 2027 (Grade 5) and Cambridge Lower Secondary Checkpoint March 2027 (Grade 8) examinations. As part of this process, a Pre-Submission Statement of Entry (PSOE) will be sent home with your ward (01 Oct 2026 )

 

Cambridge Checkpoint assessments provide an international benchmark of learner performance and help schools identify strengths and areas for further development. The assessments are externally marked by Cambridge International Education in English, Mathematics, and Science, ensuring a globally recognised standard of evaluation.

 

Over the years, Sancta Maria International School learners have consistently performed above the international average in Cambridge Checkpoint assessments, reflecting the school's commitment to academic excellence and high-quality teaching and learning practices.

 

We kindly request that you:

 

Carefully review all information provided in the Pre-Submission Statement of Entry (PSOE) sent home with your ward on dd/mm/yy.
Sign the Consent Form provided on the reverse side of the PSOE.
Return the duly signed document to the Class Teacher by 08 Oct 2026.
Please ensure all candidate details are accurate, as the information submitted will appear on Cambridge-issued documents and certificates. Any subsequent changes may attract additional Cambridge fees.




Examination Fees

 

Cambridge Primary Checkpoint (Grade 5): INR 8,499

Cambridge Lower Secondary Checkpoint (Grade 8): INR 12,129

 

The examination fee will be assigned during the first week of October 2026 and you will be notified over the email/Friday dairy. We request you to complete the payment on or before 30 October 2026.

 

Should you have any questions regarding the registration process, please feel free to contact the school.

 

Thank you for your cooperation and support.

 

Warm regards,

Team Sancta Maria

Dear Learners,

Tomorrow is your English examination. Remember that you have already done a wonderful job preparing. Stay calm and use today for focused revision.

Revise Smartly

Review important class notes, worksheets, revision papers and suggested answers shared on Teams.
Revise the features and structure of each writing genre.
Quickly go through grammar, punctuation, vocabulary and literary devices.
Focus more on areas where you made mistakes during practice.
Do not try to complete every worksheet again tonight.

Tonight

Avoid trying to revise everything again.
Do a short and focused revision.
Organise everything you need for tomorrow.
Get enough rest and come to school with a fresh mind.

In the Exam Hall

Read the text and every question carefully.
Pay attention to key words in the question and the marks given.
Underline key ideas and use evidence from the text where needed.
Do not leave questions blank. If one takes too long, move on and return to it later.
Plan before writing and organise your ideas into clear paragraphs.
Proofread for grammar, spelling and punctuation.
Keep your answer script neat.

Believe in yourself. You have worked hard, practised well, and shown great improvement. Stay confident, read carefully, and give your best effort.

All the very best!
